prompt:

Natural continuous hair strands, never layered plastic plates.
BACKGROUND MUST BE TRUE TRANSPARENCY, including between limbs. No background scene, floor, pedestal, throne, painted checkerboard, baked drop shadow, text, UI, border, lettering or watermark. No detached decoration, duplicate character, huge aura cloud, giant background summon or particle confetti. Tiny localized existing glows attached to armor/weapon may remain.
